about_the_game:
“Bless You Again“

Rogue-like 3D action shooting game

Lily, a homunculus girl who is a magician, dives into a dungeon called “Tomb of Blessings” for a certain purpose.

There, she will “risk her life” to challenge the ordeal that awaits her.

Contents

  • 3D models and animations faithfully reproduced from cell animation

  • Simple 3D actions such as melee attacks, mid-range magic, and aiming magic

  • Special move magic can be used when conditions are met!

  • Aim for deeper levels by conquering dungeons!

  • There are enemies, traps, and treasure chests in the dungeon. Explore and strengthen yourself!

  • Defeat enemies, gain experience, and obtain blessings to strengthen your status!

  • Powerful blessings may be hidden in bosses and rare treasure chests!

  • When your health reaches 0, you have to start over from the first level, but you can bring back only one blessing!

short_description: Lily” is a magician and a homunculus. She challenges a dungeon named “Tomb of Blessings” in search of a certain blessing! The player controls a character faithfully reproduced from the cel animation and defeats many monsters in search of a powerful blessing.

English, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
